verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API and knowledge base, and Financial Connections docs explicitly call out an agent use case ('Financial insights for agents' with agent-powered spending analysis and balance/transaction monitoring), confirmed by a live docs probe at docs.stripe.com/mcp. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that Financial Connections-specific tools (balances, transactions, ownership) are exposed via the MCP server, and no community reports of using it.
